newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Wattyl buys Lenmar Inc for US$5.75 mln.
newsitem.headline: Wattyl buys Lenmar Inc for US$5.75 mln.

text.p: Australian paint producer Wattyl Ltd said on Monday that it had acquired United States-based specialty industrial coatings group Lenmar Inc for US$5.7 million, effective May 1.
Wattyl said Lenmar was based in Baltimore, Maryland, and was expected to achieve a net profit of more than US$750,000 on sales of US$18 million at the end of its first year.
"The acquired operation is expected to provide a small contribution to the current year's results," it said.
Lenmar's acquisition would be funded by U.S. borrowings and would be managed by the current Wattyl management team in the United States.
"The acquisition of Lenmar Inc is in line with the group's objective of adding value to its overseas operations through strategic acquisitions," Wattyl said.
